title: 萃取与反应后处理
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/168_萃取与反应后处理.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/168_萃取与反应后处理/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜里的分液漏斗旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a separatory funnel held in a ring inside a fume hood, two liquid layers visible, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第六课：萃取与反应后处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜做放气手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing safety goggles mimes holding an upside-down funnel and pointing its tip away toward the back of the hood.
shots.narration: 分液漏斗会憋气，放气有讲究。

shots.scene: 阿杰在开放台面装满分液漏斗猛摇，塞子被顶起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shakes a completely full separatory funnel hard on an open bench, the stopper popping up with a spray, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰装得满满，猛摇不放气。

shots.scene: 阿杰放气时尖嘴对着同学
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens the stopcock with the tip pointing at a classmate, crossed out.
shots.narration: 放气时，尖嘴还对着同学。

shots.scene: 小研叫停，指向通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to the fume hood and her goggles.
shots.narration: 小研：停！进通风柜，从头来。

shots.scene: 反应瓶里是产物、副产物、原料混在一起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reaction flask with mixed icons of product, side product, leftover starting material and reagent. No text.
shots.narration: 反应得到的，是一锅粗混合物。

shots.scene: 都溶在溶液里，过滤没用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel with filter paper and a fully dissolved solution passing straight through, a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 都溶在溶液里，过滤分不开。

shots.scene: 反应结束先加水淬灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water added slowly to a cooled reaction flask in an ice bath, a stop icon over the reaction arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 反应结束，常先加水慢慢淬灭。

shots.scene: 萃取和洗涤的顺序，叫后处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flow of steps, extraction, washing, drying, filtering and solvent removal, arrows between icons. No text.
shots.narration: 萃取洗涤排好顺序，就是后处理。

shots.scene: 实验室、工业都用萃取
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plant leaf and a metal ion icon each with an arrow into a separatory funnel. No text.
shots.narration: 提取天然产物、金属，都用萃取。

shots.scene: 两种互不相溶的溶剂分两层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a separatory funnel with an organic layer on top and a water layer below, a sharp boundary line. No text.
shots.narration: 两种互不相溶的溶剂，分成两层。

shots.scene: 能混成一层就分不开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two solvents mixing into one single layer with a question mark, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 能互溶成一层，就分不开了。

shots.scene: 中性分子去有机相，离子去水相
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: neutral molecule icons moving into the top organic layer, charged ion icons moving into the water layer. No text.
shots.narration: 中性分子爱有机相，离子盐爱水相。

shots.scene: 加碱水，有机酸变盐进水层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: base solution added to the funnel, an acid molecule turning into a charged salt and dropping into the water layer, a neutral molecule staying above. No text.
shots.narration: 加碱水，有机酸变成盐，进水层。

shots.scene: 萃取拉出产物，洗涤洗走杂质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: on one side product icons pulled into a kept flask, on the other side impurity icons washed into a discard beaker. No text.
shots.narration: 萃取把产物拉出来，洗涤洗走杂质。

shots.scene: 确认前哪层都不丢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two labeled beakers holding both layers kept side by side, a trash bin crossed out, a question mark over the product. No text.
shots.narration: 没确认产物到手，哪层都别丢。

shots.scene: 上有塞子，下有活塞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pear-shaped separatory funnel with a stopper at the top and a stopcock at the bottom, arrows pointing to each. No text.
shots.narration: 上口塞子，下面活塞，中间分层。

shots.scene: 玻璃活塞薄涂润滑脂；四氟活塞不涂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin film of grease on a glass stopcock away from the hole, a white plastic stopcock with no grease and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃活塞薄涂一点脂，四氟的不涂。

shots.scene: 【实拍】装清水，看活塞和塞子漏不漏
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a separatory funnel partly filled with water, the stopcock closed, a dry tissue under the tip, then inverted to check the stopper.
shots.narration: 先装清水，看活塞塞子漏不漏。

shots.scene: 打开活塞看流得顺，漏就换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water flowing smoothly through the open stopcock, a leaking funnel set aside with a replace arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 流得顺才用，漏液就换一个。

shots.scene: 【实拍】铁圈加软垫圈，托稳漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a separatory funnel set into an iron ring fitted with a soft cork or rubber ring on a stand, checked for stability.
shots.narration: 铁圈加软垫圈，稳稳托住漏斗。

shots.scene: 下面放干净的接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean flask placed under the funnel tip to catch any leak. No text.
shots.narration: 下面放好接收瓶，漏了也能接住。

shots.scene: 【实拍】关好活塞，经小漏斗装液
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand checks the stopcock is closed, then pours liquid through a small funnel into the separatory funnel, the beaker rinsed after.
shots.narration: 先关活塞，经小漏斗倒入，冲洗原瓶。

shots.scene: 装好液体，塞紧上口塞子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the matching stopper pressed into the top of the filled separatory funnel, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 装好后，塞紧配套的塞子。

shots.scene: 装液不超过四分之三
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a separatory funnel with a fill line at about three quarters, an overfilled funnel crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 装液不超过四分之三，太满混不开。

shots.scene: 易燃溶剂在通风柜里萃取
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student in goggles doing an extraction inside a fume hood, solvent bottles with flammable pictograms. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂萃取，放在通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 蒸气贴着台面跑，远离火源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: heavy vapor creeping along the bench toward a hot plate and a spark icon, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸气贴着台面跑，远离火和热源。

shots.scene: 用完盖紧，久放乙醚查过氧化物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capped solvent bottle going back into a flammable storage cabinet, an old bottle with a date icon and a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 用完盖紧放回，久放乙醚按规定查。

shots.scene: 沾上溶剂立即换手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gloved hand splashed with solvent, the glove removed and a new one put on. No text.
shots.narration: 溶剂易透过手套，沾上就换。

shots.scene: 充分混合，分配更快
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two layers mixing into fine droplets with a large contact surface, arrows of molecules crossing. No text.
shots.narration: 充分混合，接触面大，分配更快。

shots.scene: 混合使压力升高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed funnel with pressure arrows pushing on the stopper, a volatile solvent icon and a gas bubble icon. No text.
shots.narration: 一混合压力就升高，挥发产气更明显。

shots.scene: 【实拍】一手按住塞子倒置，一手握活塞
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: one hand presses the stopper firmly while turning the separatory funnel upside down, the other hand holding the stopcock, the liquid away from the stopcock.
shots.narration: 按住塞子倒过来，一手握住活塞。

shots.scene: 【实拍】尖嘴朝通风柜内侧，慢开活塞放气
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the inverted funnel tip pointing up toward the back of the fume hood, away from people, the stopcock opened slowly to release vapor.
shots.narration: 尖嘴朝柜内、不对人，慢开放气。

shots.scene: 先轻摇，勤放气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gentle swirl icon followed by a vent icon repeated several times, small shakes first then stronger ones. No text.
shots.narration: 先轻轻旋摇，放气要勤。

shots.scene: 摇几秒放一次，直到没有嘶声
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cycle of shake a few seconds and vent, a sound wave icon getting smaller until silent. No text.
shots.narration: 摇几秒放一次，直到听不到出气声。

shots.scene: 不放气，塞子会冲出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopper shooting out of a funnel with spray, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不放气，塞子冲出、液体喷溅。

shots.scene: 振摇放气全程戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student wearing safety goggles and gloves shaking a funnel inside a fume hood with the sash lowered. No text.
shots.narration: 振摇放气会喷溅，全程戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 两层中间糊一层：乳化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel with a cloudy foggy band between two layers, a magnifier showing fine particles. No text.
shots.narration: 两层中间糊一层，这叫乳化。

shots.scene: 轻摇颠倒很少乳化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gentle rocking motion of a funnel with a check mark, a violent shake with a cross. No text.
shots.narration: 轻轻旋摇颠倒，就很少乳化。

shots.scene: 静置等待，玻璃棒轻搅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel standing with a clock icon, a glass rod gently stirring the cloudy band. No text.
shots.narration: 乳化了：静置等，或玻璃棒轻搅。

shots.scene: 加饱和食盐水破乳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a few milliliters of saturated salt water added, the cloudy band shrinking into a clear boundary. No text.
shots.narration: 加少量饱和食盐水，帮助分层。

shots.scene: 最后一招：硅藻土抽滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the whole emulsion filtered under vacuum through a pad of diatomaceous earth, two clear layers collected. No text.
shots.narration: 最后一招，整体用硅藻土抽滤。

shots.scene: 随时清楚哪层在上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a funnel with two layers and a thinking bubble asking which layer holds which molecules. No text.
shots.narration: 随时问：哪层在上，产物在哪层？

shots.scene: 密度小在上：己烷、乙醚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light solvent floating above water in one funnel, a heavy solvent sinking below water in another funnel. No text.
shots.narration: 己烷乙醚比水轻在上，二氯甲烷在下。

shots.scene: 溶质很浓时密度会变
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water layer loaded with dissolved salt icons getting heavier, an arrow showing the layers can swap. No text.
shots.narration: 溶质很浓，密度也会变，别只靠记。

shots.scene: 拿不准就加点水，变多的是水层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a little water added to the funnel, the lower layer growing taller with an up arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 拿不准就加点水，变多的是水层。

shots.scene: 【实拍】取几滴滴进水里试
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a dropper adds a few drops of the lower layer into a small tube of water, the drops dissolving clearly, then oil drops floating in another tube.
shots.narration: 取几滴进水：溶了是水层，分层是油层。

shots.scene: 下面放贴标签的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two beakers with blank labels placed ready under the funnel. No text.
shots.narration: 下面放好贴标签的烧杯。

shots.scene: 【实拍】先取下上口塞子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand removes the stopper from the top of the separatory funnel before opening the stopcock.
shots.narration: 先取下塞子，不然放不下来。

shots.scene: 【实拍】放出下层，近界面放慢，到活塞即关
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the lower colored water layer drains slowly into a beaker, the boundary reaching the stopcock and the stopcock closed right there.
shots.narration: 放下层，快到界面放慢，到了就关。

shots.scene: 【实拍】上层从上口倒出
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the separatory funnel lifted and the upper oil layer poured out from the top opening into a second labeled beaker.
shots.narration: 上层从上口倒，不沾下层残液。

shots.scene: 要再洗的上层留在漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the upper layer kept in the funnel with a wash solution arrow coming in, a done layer poured into a labeled beaker. No text.
shots.narration: 上层还要洗，就留在漏斗里。

shots.scene: 一次萃不净，再萃一两次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the water layer returned to the funnel with fresh solvent, the shake and vent cycle repeated. No text.
shots.narration: 一次萃不干净，换新溶剂再萃。

shots.scene: 少量多次，合并萃取液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two small portions of extract combined into one flask, a higher yield icon. No text.
shots.narration: 少量多次，萃取液合并，收率更高。

shots.scene: 看杂质性质选洗液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: impurity icons of an acid, a base and water matched by arrows to three wash bottles. No text.
shots.narration: 根据杂质的性质，选洗液。

shots.scene: 每次少量，每种洗两三次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small wash portions repeated two or three times for each wash solution. No text.
shots.narration: 每次用量少，每种洗两三次。

shots.scene: 饱和碳酸氢钠洗去酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: saturated sodium bicarbonate solution added to the funnel, acid icons reacting and many gas bubbles forming. No text.
shots.narration: 碳酸氢钠洗去酸，会放出二氧化碳。

shots.scene: 产气多：先敞口轻旋，再勤放气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the funnel swirled gently with the stopper off until fizzing slows, then stoppered and vented very often. No text.
shots.narration: 先不加塞轻轻旋，冒泡少了再塞。

shots.scene: 稀盐酸洗去胺类
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dilute hydrochloric acid added to wash out amine icons into the water layer, goggles and gloves icons. No text.
shots.narration: 稀盐酸洗去胺，戴好护目镜手套。

shots.scene: 饱和食盐水洗，带走部分水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a saturated salt water wash pulling water droplets out of the organic layer. No text.
shots.narration: 饱和食盐水洗一次，带走部分水。

shots.scene: 加干燥剂，把水吸进固体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the organic layer in a flask with a spatula adding drying agent, water droplets captured into the solid. No text.
shots.narration: 有机层还有水，加干燥剂吸掉。

shots.scene: 【实拍】少量多次加，摇成雪花球
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a spatula adds anhydrous drying agent to a flask a little at a time while swirling, some fine powder swirling freely like a snow globe.
shots.narration: 少量多次，摇起来像雪花球就够了。

shots.scene: 硫酸镁快但细且偏酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fast clock icon by a fine white powder, a small acid icon and product molecules sticking to the powder. No text.
shots.narration: 硫酸镁快，但粉细会吸附，略偏酸。

shots.scene: 硫酸钠慢些但中性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: coarse white granules with a slower clock icon of five to ten minutes and a neutral icon. No text.
shots.narration: 硫酸钠慢些，中性，等五到十分钟。

shots.scene: 【实拍】折叠滤纸滤掉干燥剂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the dried solution poured through a fan-folded filter paper in a funnel into a round-bottom flask, the drying agent left behind.
shots.narration: 折叠滤纸滤掉干燥剂。

shots.scene: 干溶剂冲洗三次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a little dry solvent rinsing the flask and the drying agent three times into the receiver. No text.
shots.narration: 用干溶剂冲洗三次，别留下产物。

shots.scene: 加热板敞口蒸溶剂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an open beaker of solvent on a hot plate with vapor and a flame icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂，别在加热板上敞口蒸。

shots.scene: 转入圆底烧瓶，旋转蒸发除溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the filtrate in a round-bottom flask attached to a rotary evaporator inside a ventilated area, a do not dry out icon. No text.
shots.narration: 转入圆底瓶，用旋转蒸发，不蒸干。

shots.scene: 演示只是预习，讲义要读
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab manual book open beside a separatory funnel, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 先读实验讲义，按步骤做。

shots.scene: 水层里的盐，酸化变回有机酸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the water layer with salt icons, acid added slowly while swirling, molecules changing back to neutral acid. No text.
shots.narration: 水层里的盐，慢慢加酸变回来。

shots.scene: 在通风柜里慢慢加酸，会放热
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: acid added drop by drop to the water layer inside a fume hood, a small heat icon and a goggles icon. No text.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里慢加，会放热，别急。

shots.scene: 试纸显酸性就够了
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass rod touching a drop onto a pH test strip turning to the acid color. No text.
shots.narration: 边加边摇，试纸显酸性就够了。

shots.scene: 冰水浴促析出，抽滤收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: white solid forming in a beaker set in an ice bath, then collected by vacuum filtration and dried in an oven. No text.
shots.narration: 冰水浴促析出，抽滤收集再干燥。

shots.scene: 含卤与不含卤有机废液分开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two labeled organic waste containers, one with a halogen icon and one without, a solvent poured into the right one. No text.
shots.narration: 含卤和不含卤的有机废液分开收。

shots.scene: 洗涤水层按规定收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: aqueous washings poured into a labeled aqueous waste container, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 洗涤水层按本校规定收集，不倒水槽。

shots.scene: 用过的干燥剂进固体废物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used drying agent and filter paper placed into a labeled solid chemical waste bin. No text.
shots.narration: 用过的干燥剂、滤纸进固废桶。

shots.scene: 试漏、托稳、不过四分之三
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a separatory funnel with check icons for leak test, ring support and a three quarter fill line. No text.
shots.narration: 试漏托稳，装液不过四分之三。

shots.scene: 倒置放气，尖嘴不对人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inverted funnel venting toward the back of a fume hood, a person icon out of the line of the tip. No text.
shots.narration: 通风柜里倒置放气，尖嘴不对人。

shots.scene: 下放上倒，确认前不丢层，干燥过滤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lower layer draining down, upper layer poured from the top, two labeled beakers kept, a drying agent flask. No text.
shots.narration: 下放上倒，哪层都先留，干燥过滤。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在蒸馏装置旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a simple distillation setup with a round-bottom flask, a condenser and a receiving flask, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：常压蒸馏。
